### 1. What the caller expresses, and how the simulator behaves

- Object: an extension on her current trip — "she asked the host last weekend whether she could hang on to
  the car for two more days, heard nothing back at all, and has since seen that the request went stale. She
  wants to put the same ask in again, the same two extra days".
- Timing: now, before she commits — "she wants to know what the extra time is going to cost her before she
  commits to it".
- Boundary, stated explicitly and narrowly: "she is not asking for the trip's dates to be moved today - only
  for the request to go in front of the host again with a price on it". "What the trip itself has or has not
  been billed for she leaves to the desk."
- Authorisation: "she will lodge it herself if that is how it is done"; "Once the agent has set the request
  up and passed it over to her, she lodges it herself".

Identifiers: name + mobile `4255610994` first; then DOB `2002-11-30`, ZIP `98033`; licence `51683042` and
email `tessa.fontaine@northmail.com` only if needed. "She has no idea what her booking reference is."
The simulator is passive — it answers what it is asked, hands nothing over unasked, executes the user-owned
tool only after the agent unlocks and passes it, and when the agent goes quiet "she only says she can wait a
minute". She explicitly refuses to supply the two facts that would pre-solve the computation: "she could not
name the level if her life depended on it and says the agent had better look it up", and "She does not know
what the marketplace charges for extra time and will not guess at it."

### 4. Each scored parameter, in words, with its ladder and the returns that fix the tier

#### 4a. `surcharge_amount` — the young-driver surcharge line

Baseline, `young_driver_surcharge_computation_90b4076c`: "The surcharge is the effective surcharge rate taken
on the amount charged over, rounded to the nearest cent once at the end"; "The amount charged over is the
base-rate line standing on the Keyturn Trip Booking reservation spread evenly over the days of the reserved
period and taken for each day charged ... by dividing it by the days of the reserved period, the resulting
daily figure being taken to the nearest cent; that daily figure is then taken for each day charged"; "The
effective surcharge rate is the surcharge rate with the protection adjustment, the conduct adjustment and the
additional-driver adjustment applied to it, each of them in percentage points and all of them added together
to the rate before the rate is taken on anything". Standard values stated there: rate 15 per cent, the three
adjustments each 0 percentage points, days charged = the days the trip has already run to the day the
surcharge is raised, that day counted.

| Input | Document that decides it | Tier reached, and the record that puts it there | Value |
|---|---|---|---|
| Surcharge rate | `young_driver_surcharge_rate_by_security_9eb9d663` | Reserved period "14 days or more" (exactly 14; the document says 14 "is reached rather than passed") **and** "a deposit line stands on the reservation" (`charge_basis='deposit'`, 400.00) | **9 per cent** |
| Protection adjustment | `young_driver_protection_adjustment_94952a2c` | All three limbs of row 1: `status='active'`; "written as Keyturn Premier Protection"; protection fees "800.00 USD or more" (728.00 + 109.20 = 837.20; even the daily-fee line alone clears 800.00). **Rests on another product's records** | **−4 pp** |
| Conduct adjustment | `young_driver_allowance_conduct_adjustment_43eb99aa` | Readings booked 1000 miles; three quarters of the 1225 granted is 918.75; 1000 is "More than three quarters of it but not more than it"; trip run "7 or more" days | **+1 pp** |
| Additional-driver adjustment | `young_driver_declared_driver_adjustment_803ee939` | "Exactly 1" additional driver declared on the trip's protection election (`declared_secondary_driver_count=1`) **and** reserved period "14 days or more". **Rests on another product's records** | **+2 pp** |
| Days charged | `young_driver_charged_days_anchor_0eba8be9` | `actual_start_date='2026-09-05'` equals `trip_start_date`, i.e. "the trip started on the first day of the reserved period", **and** the trip has run "7 or more" days → "the days charged run from the first day of the reserved period to the scheduled return, the day of return counted" = 2026-09-05 → 2026-09-18 inclusive | **14 days** |

Assembly: effective rate = 9 − 4 + 1 + 2 = **8 per cent** (the document pins the order: "the percentage points
are added to the rate first, and only then is the resulting rate taken on the amount charged over").
Daily figure = 1084.16 / 14 = 77.44 exactly. Amount charged over = 77.44 × 14 = **1084.16 USD**.
Surcharge = 8% × 1084.16 = 86.7328 → **86.73 USD**.

**`surcharge_amount` = 86.73 USD.**

#### 4b. `quoted_amount`, `additional_hours`, `requested_end_date` — the extension quote

Baseline, `extension_quote_computation_e0fe1bd2`: "The quote is the price of the extended time, with the
young-driver share and the register lodgement charge added to it and the cover credit taken off it, taken as
nothing where that comes out below nothing, and rounded to the nearest cent once at the end"; "The price of
the extended time is the locked daily rate ... lifted by the extension uplift, taken for each extended day,
where the extended days are the extra time quoted divided by 24 and rounded up to the next whole day, never
fewer than one day"; "The cover credit is the credit given for each extended day, taken for each of the
extended days". Standard values stated there: uplift 8 per cent, extra time quoted 72 hours, no young-driver
share, lodgement charge 0.00 USD, cover credit 0.00 USD for each extended day.

| Input | Document that decides it | Tier reached, and the record that puts it there | Value |
|---|---|---|---|
| Extra time quoted | `extension_quoted_time_selection_145ce55d` | "At least one that expired without a decision" (`request_status='expired'` on `93eac519-…`) **and** trip run "7 or more" days → "The extra time the latest such expired request asked for" = `additional_hours=48.0` | **48 hours → 2 extended days** |
| Extension uplift | `extension_uplift_after_lapsed_requests_cbd1e4dd` | Same two limbs → row 1 | **4 per cent** |
| Register lodgement charge | `extension_register_lodgement_charge_c029df78` | "Exactly 1" extension request already standing on the reservation; "Every extension request standing against the reservation is counted, whatever state it stands in — submitted, approved, declined or expired alike" | **12.00 USD** |
| Cover credit | `extension_protection_cover_credit_b9c9275c` | Election "Stands active" **and** fees "800.00 USD or more" (837.20). **Rests on another product's records** | **14.00 USD for each extended day** |
| Young-driver share | `extension_young_driver_share_basis_bf64bc7b` | A young-driver surcharge stands on the reservation (once 4a is posted) **and** the extra time runs to "2 or more" extended days → "The surcharge divided by the days of the reserved period, taken for each extended day", the daily share "taken to the nearest cent" | 86.73 / 14 = 6.195 → **6.20 × 2 = 12.40 USD** |

Assembly: uplifted daily rate = 88.00 × 1.04 = 91.52 (to the nearest cent); × 2 extended days = **183.04 USD**
price of the extended time. Plus the young-driver share 12.40, plus the lodgement charge 12.00, less the
cover credit 14.00 × 2 = 28.00 → 183.04 + 12.40 + 12.00 − 28.00 = **179.44 USD**. Above nothing.

**`quoted_amount` = 179.44 USD; `additional_hours` = 48.0; `requested_end_date` = '2026-09-20'** (the
scheduled return 2026-09-18 plus the two extended days; the same date the expired request asked for).

### 6. The problem tree derived from the visible materials alone

**Problems:** P1 — the young-driver surcharge owed on the named driver is raised on the reservation;
P2 — the guest's own request to keep the vehicle longer is quoted and lodged.
**Direction:** P2 depends on P1. **Handling order:** P1, then P2.

**Hop P2 → P1 — marked `state-derived`.**

- Sentence read, in `extension_quote_desk_note_fa4311e0` (the hub of the blocked problem, P2):
  "A quote for extra time is not fixed before the reservation carries the young-driver surcharge owed on the
  driver named on it." Restated in the same document and in the same state form: "Until the surcharge owed on
  the named driver is carried by the reservation, the quote for the extra time is not yet fixed." Neither
  sentence names a tool, a performer, a policy or another document. The waited-on thing is a **record state**:
  the reservation carrying the surcharge.
- Records checked: `find_trips_charges(booking_id='ee1d196c-…')` returns four rows — `base_rate`,
  `trip_fee`, `deposit` and a goodwill `trips_refund_issued`. **No young-driver line stands on the
  reservation**, so the waited-on state does not hold at the frozen moment. The 109.20 USD
  `young_driver_protection_surcharge` returned by `find_guestplan_charges` is a line on the *protection
  election*, not on the reservation, and the blocked sentence speaks of what "the reservation carries".
- Search for the write that brings that state about, using the words the sentence and the records use —
  "young-driver surcharge", "the reservation carries", "line": the title "The Young-Driver Surcharge Line on
  a Keyturn Trip Booking Reservation" (`young_driver_surcharge_desk_note_d39f5dcf`) matches, and its own rule
  supplies the write: "A driver under the young-driver threshold on the first day of the reserved period owes

  `driver_eligibility_and_request_acceptance_8907046a` fixes the moment — "a driver below the young-driver
  threshold on that day pays the young-driver surcharge for the whole trip"; and
  `rate_plan_trip_fee_and_deposit_schedule_16c6971e` gives the threshold as 25 whole years. 23 < 25.
- Corroboration (not the basis of the hop): `extension_young_driver_share_basis_bf64bc7b` prices row 1 on

**No further hops.** P1's hub carries no prerequisite sentence of its own; all its inputs (the base-rate line,

### Two-way counter-proof

**The closest alternatives, and the visible sentence or record that excludes each:**

| Closest alternative | What excludes it |
|---|---|
| Quote 72 hours (the plan's longest extension / the baseline's standard extra time) | `extension_quoted_time_selection_145ce55d` row 1: an expired request stands and the trip has run 7+ days → "The extra time the latest such expired request asked for" (48.0). |
| Uplift 8 per cent (the baseline standard, and the Keyturn Weekly Rate Plan's published uplift on `rate_plan_extension_terms_schedule_30e441c9`) | `extension_uplift_after_lapsed_requests_cbd1e4dd` row 1 → 4 per cent. |
| Treat the 109.20 USD `young_driver_protection_surcharge` as the surcharge already standing, and add no line | It stands on the protection election, not on the reservation; `young_driver_surcharge_desk_note_d39f5dcf` requires "its own priced line on that reservation", and `find_trips_charges` shows none. |
| Surcharge rate 15 per cent (baseline) or 12 per cent (the Monthly column) or 18 per cent | `young_driver_surcharge_rate_by_security_9eb9d663` row 1: 14 reserved days and a deposit line standing → 9 per cent. The plan card's 15 per cent for the Weekly plan is the *standard* the ladder displaces. |
| Days charged = the 11–12 days the trip has run (baseline) | `young_driver_charged_days_anchor_0eba8be9` row 2: the trip started on the first day of the reserved period and has run 7+ days → counted to the scheduled return, that day counted = 14. |
| Apply each adjustment to the money in turn | "Note the order: the percentage points are added to the rate first ... The rate is never taken on the amount once for each adjustment." |
| Compute the young-driver share as 86.73 × 2 / 14 = 12.39 | `extension_young_driver_share_basis_bf64bc7b`: "the daily share is taken to the nearest cent" — 6.195 → 6.20, then ×2 = 12.40. |
| Move the trip's dates today | Her own boundary, plus "A request standing on the extension request register is not a change to the reservation" and the tool's own return contract ("The reservation itself is untouched by the call"). |
| Refuse the whole request because 48 + 48 = 96 exceeds the plan's 72-hour maximum | "A declined or expired request leaves the reservation untouched" — the expired request added nothing to the reservation, so the aggregate against the maximum is the 48 hours now asked for. |
| Charge the date-change fee of 35.00 USD (Keyturn Weekly Rate Plan) for the lodgement | `extension_register_lodgement_charge_c029df78` states it is "not the fee the marketplace charges for a date change once a reservation's free date changes are used". |

**Boundaries the source leaves open** (policy-side notes; none changes the answer here): the inclusive/
exclusive reading of "the days the trip has run" (11 or 12, both "7 or more"); and the mild tension between
the extension computation's "rounded to the nearest cent once at the end" and its own pinned intermediate
roundings ("The locked daily rate lifted by the uplift is taken to the nearest cent, and the product ... is
taken to the nearest cent in its turn") — every figure here lands exact, so nothing turns on it.

**Counter-proof against the wrong answer "do only the one thing the customer asked for".** She asked only for
a priced request to be lodged; she explicitly leaves the rest alone ("What the trip itself has or has not
been billed for she leaves to the desk"). Lodging only that is excluded by the visible principle:
"A quote for extra time is not fixed before the reservation carries the young-driver surcharge owed on the
driver named on it" — with no such line on the reservation, the quote is by the documents' own words not yet
fixed, and `extension_young_driver_share_basis_bf64bc7b` would take its third row ("no young-driver share is
added") and produce 167.04 USD instead of 179.44 USD. The exclusion rests on a state-form prerequisite
sentence plus the charge rows plus her date of birth, not on any routed statement.

**Counter-proof on the calculation — the fall-back numbers.** Reading only the computation documents and the
product figures they name, with no factor applied:
- Young-driver surcharge: 1084.16 / 14 = 77.44 daily, taken for the 12 days the trip has run to the day the
  surcharge is raised = 929.28; 15 per cent of that = **139.39 USD**.
- Extension quote: 88.00 × 1.08 = 95.04; the standard extra time of 72 hours is 3 extended days;
  95.04 × 3 = **285.12 USD**, with no share, no lodgement charge and no cover credit.
Both are definite and both differ from 86.73 / 179.44, so every declared factor bears weight.

| 4b-i | Uplift **4 %**; extra time **48 h**; 2 extended days; extension price **183.04** | `uplift_repeat = 4`; `extra_hours = 48.0`; `extended_days = 2`; `extension_price = 183.04` | same |
| 4b-ii | Young-driver share **12.40** — daily share 86.73/14 = 6.195 rounded to 6.20, taken for 2 days | `yd_share = RND(surcharge_line / reserved_days_b * extended_days, 2) = RND(108.42 / 14 x 2, 2) = 15.49` — one rounding, at the end | **DIFFERENT**, on two independent grounds (the surcharge it spreads, and where the rounding falls) |
| 4b-iii | Lodgement charge **12.00** | `lodgement_first = 12.0` | same |
| 4b-iv | Cover credit **14.00** a day = 28.00 | `cover_credit_low = 9.0` a day = 18.00; `elec_fees_b = 728.00 < 800` | **DIFFERENT** |
| 4b | `quoted_amount` = **179.44** | `expected: 192.53` | **DIFFERENT** |
| 4b-args | `requested_end_date` = '2026-09-20', `additional_hours` = 48.0 | identical in `evaluation_criteria` | same |
| 5 | `post_young_driver_surcharge_8e3312c3` (agent) then `submit_extension_request_8f69bfd6` (user) | `evaluation_criteria` actions 9–12: identical tools, owners, order and ids | **same** |
| 6 | Tree = {young-driver surcharge, extension quote}; quote depends on the surcharge; hop **state-derived** | `prerequisite_closure.root_problem = trips_ext_extension_quote`; one edge to `trips_ext_young_driver_surcharge`, `form: state`, `policy_source` identical to the sentence quoted blind | **same** |

### Divergences, with their root cause

**D-1 — the protection-fee limb.** Three factors read "the protection fees charged on" the trip's protection
election against a threshold. The source pins that reading to the election's **daily protection fee** lines:
`inputs.history[…].filters.charge_basis = "daily_protection_fee"`, and in `compute`
`elec_fees_c = XSUM('guestplan','guestplan_charges','charge_amount', charge_basis='daily_protection_fee', booking_id=HID)`.
This trip's election carries two lines — 728.00 `daily_protection_fee` and 109.20
`young_driver_protection_surcharge` — so the source reads **728.00**, below the 800.00 floor.

The published documents nowhere restrict the reading; two of them positively direct the opposite:
- `young_driver_protection_adjustment_94952a2c`: "The fees read are those charged on the trip's own
  protection election, taken together."
- `mileage_topup_block_price_by_protection_47c299c3`: "The protection fees read are the fees charged on the
  trip's own protection election, taken together."
- `extension_protection_cover_credit_b9c9275c` states only "what is read is whether it stands active and the
  protection fees charged on it", with no restriction at all.
The words "daily protection fee" appear in **no** document of `docs/trips/`
(`grep -il "daily protection fee" docs/trips/*.json` returns nothing), while `find_guestplan_charges` returns
both rows under the same `event_type='guestplan_protection_fee_charged'`.

A reader of the published corpus therefore reaches 837.20 and takes the wrong tier of two separate ladders.
The source's own `factor_trace` names this exact outcome as the error: "a reader who folds it in reaches
837.20, takes the first tier's four points off instead, and gets 86.73" — which is precisely the figure this
blind audit reached. Consequence: `surcharge_amount` 86.73 instead of 108.42, and `quoted_amount` off by the
cover credit as well.

**D-2 — the young-driver share's rounding.** The source's `young_driver_share_basis` ladder says only "the
young-driver share is that surcharge spread evenly over the days of the reserved period and taken for each
extended day", and its `compute` rounds once: `RND(surcharge_line / reserved_days_b * extended_days, 2)`.
`extension_young_driver_share_basis_bf64bc7b` adds a rounding the source does not have: "the daily share is
taken to the nearest cent." This is independently outcome-bearing: even a solver who reads the fees the
source's way reaches 108.42 / 14 = 7.744285… → 7.74, doubled to 15.48, and quotes **192.52** against the
scored **192.53**.

### Verdict

**KB-RUNTIME RED** for task 1.

- The visible KB does not entail the source layer's scored numbers for either parameter: 86.73 against
  108.42, and 179.44 against 192.53 (192.52 even with D-1 corrected).
- Root causes: a declared factor's tier condition carried at a different reading (D-1, three documents), and
  a rounding step added to a factor's method that the source does not have (D-2, one document).
- What is **not** at fault: the problem tree, the ordering, the tool selection, the owners, the identifiers,
  `requested_end_date`, `additional_hours`, and every other tier of every other ladder — all of which the
  blind audit reached correctly from the documents alone. The defect is confined to the two readings above.
- Not attributed to any solving agent: this is a translation defect, reproducible from the documents without
  any arithmetic slip.
